h: Turkish pundit questions Osimhen's man of the match award after Galatasaray beat Lille
p: A Turkish commentator has reportedly doubted whether Victor Osimhen deserved the Champions League man of the match award in Galatasaray's win over Lille.
more: Galatasaray took the three points in the Champions League tie.
Osimhen's form remains a major talking point among Nigerian fans.
